messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads up — our new Next.js App Router starter (edge-enabled) is showing duplicated inference calls during SSR in the LlamaIndex example.
Aisha Khan: Quick repro: run the starter in Vercel Edge, hit /ssr-chat, check outgoing requests in the telemetry UI — two requests for one render.
Aisha Khan: Minimal server snippet from the example:
```js
// app/api/chat/route.js (edge)
export const runtime = 'edge'
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
export async function POST(req) {
  const body = await req.json()
  const r = await client.chat.create({ model: 'rw-llama-7b', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: body.q }] })
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(r))
}
```
Tom Becker: Which SDK version? Does Python starter behave the same?
Aisha Khan: JS SDK @redwood/inference-js v0.9.0 from the starter. I ran the Python LlamaIndex sample in a server WSGI env and it only made one call.
Lina Gomez: Sounds like a transport retry vs SDK-level retry mismatch. Our Python SDK adds an Idempotency-Key header for server-side calls; JS historically didn't.
Tom Becker: Can you paste the raw logs? Especially headers and any retry attempt lines.
Aisha Khan: Logs (redacted):
[2026-03-01T09:12:11Z] fetch: response status=429 body="quota"
[2026-03-01T09:12:11Z] transport-retry: attempt=2 retried=true
[2026-03-01T09:12:12Z] sdk: request sent idempotency=null
[2026-03-01T09:12:12Z] sdk: response 200 tokens=34
Aisha Khan: So the fetch transport retried and the higher-level sdk also retried without an idempotency key -> double execution.
Lina Gomez: That confirms it. Short-term workaround: set client option { autoIdempotency: true } in the sample server code or disable transport-level retry in the Edge polyfill.
Tom Becker: We also need to avoid breaking browser usage. autoIdempotency should be enabled only in server/edge runtimes.
Aisha Khan: I tried setting an explicit header 'Idempotency-Key' in the example and the telemetry shows one request.
devex-bot: Issue created: redwood/platform#2078 "Edge SSR duplicate inference calls in Next.js starter" assigned to @Tom Becker
Tom Becker: I'll open a draft PR to change the sample: detect server runtime (typeof window === 'undefined' || runtime === 'edge') and pass autoIdempotency: true. Will also bump SDK in the starter to v0.9.1 with a small runtime check.
Lina Gomez: For longer-term, we should update the JS SDK to mirror Python's behavior: automatically add idempotency header for server-run contexts unless explicitly disabled. Also add unit tests simulating a transport-level retry to ensure only one upstream request occurs.
Tom Becker: Agreed. I'll add a CI test in the sample harness that runs a tiny node server and asserts outbound count === 1 when the transport returns a simulated 429 then 200.
Aisha Khan: Also: the eval harness used by the starter's quality tests currently replays requests and counts tokens from logged events. We should adjust the harness to deduplicate requests by idempotency key when present, to avoid false regressions.
QA Bot: TODO added to repo board: update-eval-harness-dedupe (P2)
Lina Gomez: Docs: add a short paragraph in quickstart "Server runtimes and idempotency" with code snippet showing safe server usage and how to opt out.
Tom Becker: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-templates/pull/99 (WIP)
Aisha Khan: I pushed a tiny README patch to my fork with the workaround. Will open PR once Tom's SDK change lands.
Tom Becker: Will coordinate with eng-runtime to ensure fetch polyfill's retry behavior is documented. Thanks for catching this early, Aisha.
Aisha Khan: No problem. Happy to run more repros if needed. :thumbsup:
